rules: Advice never advances by itself (owner decision 2026-10-31): in prebake only the author closes advice, and only where the steps say so.
Consent -> Test is automatic once the quorum (default 1 position) is met with no open objection, so any objection a fixture needs is recorded before any consent or stand-aside.
Test -> Ratified needs a steward who did not write the proposal, and a passed test report.

Leave at least 3 unreserved OmniOne proposals in Advice when the swarm starts. The gold pool has 4; 'Tool library insurance cover' and 'Tool library opening hours' are also in Advice but are reserved.
Register no agreement in prebake: the steward lane and the probe do that.
Never create anything titled '(uxqa gold)': gold-propose and gold-share create those, and the adapter withdraws them on each seed.
If the API refuses a step, record it as a finding, leave the fixture at the last stage it reached, and note in prebake.json which lane step is affected.

lanes.name: lending-rules-keyboard
lanes.journey: The main line of the scenario, with both personas driving by keyboard. (1) Ines (keyboard only: Tab, Enter, Space, arrows; never a pointer) creates 'Tool library lending rules (uxqa-p2)' from /proposals/new, with body text carrying uxqa-p2, and opens it for advice. Record whether the status change is confirmed (toast or announced text), where focus lands, and what the status banner says is waiting and who decides. (2) Ines messages Kofi in /messaging asking for his advice and pastes the proposal URL. (3) Kofi (perceives only through outline(), acts through getByRole and the keyboard) opens the proposal from the message link, reads the status banner in the accessibility tree, and gives advice carrying uxqa-p2. (4) Ines checks the notification bell and the dashboard queue for Kofi's advice and for any prompt to close advice. Record whether she understands that nothing moves until she closes advice, and when the right time is. Then she closes advice. (5) Kofi opens the bell and the proposal. Before anyone else takes a position, he records an objection with a reason (uxqa-p2), and judges from the tree alone whether consent, stand aside and object are explained well enough to choose between them. Ordering matters: one non-objecting position with no open objection moves the proposal to Test by itself. (6) Ines sees the objection (bell, banner) and revises the proposal the way the page offers. Expected: the text is locked once members decide, so she sends it back for revision with a note, edits it to add a sentence answering Kofi's reason (uxqa-p2), and closes advice again. She messages Kofi that it is revised. (7) Kofi finds how to take back his objection after the revision (withdraw it, or change his position to consent). Record whether the page makes this findable and says what happened, whether his position appears once and not twice, and whether his bell cleared. (8) Once the proposal is in Test, Kofi files a test report (outcome passed, observations uxqa-p2). Ines reads the banner and records whether she knows what happens next, who confirms (a steward who did not write it), and whether anything leaves her waiting for an automatic move. (9) Kofi opens /decisions and records whether his advice and positions appear in his ledger with names and links. The steward lane may confirm this proposal if it reaches Test with a passed report; if this lane ends with it unconfirmed, that is timing, not a defect, unless the page misstates who decides. Read focus with page.locator(':focus') and its accessible name; a rig error is a lane error, not friction. Message only qa-* personas. No assistant messages.

lanes.name: lift-share-plain-words
lanes.journey: Two friends, both already signed in. (1) Rafi (slow network, patience 1) opens his prebaked draft 'Lift share for tool pickups (uxqa-p2)' from the dashboard or /proposals and opens it for advice. When nothing seems to happen he presses again: record any double transition, error or missing loading state. (2) Rafi messages Joy in /messaging ('can you give advice on my lift share, uxqa-p2') with the link. (3) Joy (low literacy: perceives only through text(), acts only on words she can see, patience 2) finds the proposal from the message or the bell and gives advice in her own words (uxqa-p2). Before counting any of Joy's outcomes, confirm that the control she acts on exists in outline() under the visible words she used; a missing selector is a lane error, not product friction. (4) Rafi checks his bell. Does he expect the proposal to move by itself? Does anything tell him to close advice, and when? He closes advice once he sees her advice. (5) Joy goes back to the proposal and decides where she stands, using only the words on screen. She may ask the in-app assistant one plain question (for example, what 'stand aside' means); never paste persona data. Record which choice she makes and why, whether she understood that one yes moves it into a test, and whether she could change her mind afterwards. (6) Both check the bell. Does Joy's item clear after she acts, and what does Rafi's say comes next? (7) If the proposal reached Test, Rafi records what the banner says about who decides next and whether he is left waiting for something that never comes. He files a test report only if the page asks him to. Message only qa-* personas. At most two assistant messages in the lane.

lanes.name: stewards-confirm-and-register
lanes.journey: (1) Amara (200% zoom) opens the dashboard queue and the bell to see what is waiting for her. She opens 'Tool shed key holders (uxqa-p2)' (hers, in Test), files a test report (outcome passed, uxqa-p2), then tries to confirm the ratification herself. Record what she is told ('Another steward needs to confirm this'), whether the page says who can, and whether it feels like a dead end. She messages Oren with the URL and asks him to confirm. (2) Oren (browser locale de-DE) opens the bell. His 'Tool library insurance cover (uxqa-p2)' has advice in: record whether the prompt makes clear that he closes advice and when the time is right. He closes advice and checks that the banner says what happens next. (3) Oren opens Amara's message and confirms the ratification of 'Tool shed key holders (uxqa-p2)', which he did not write. Record the confirmation step, the banner afterwards, and whether Amara is told. (4) Amara finds the ratified proposal from her bell or the queue and registers it as an agreement. She checks that the agreement text equals the ratified text, reads the agreement's status banner, records a ceremony, and finds the decision in /decisions. (5) Oren opens the new agreement from /agreements, records his consent to it, and uses 'Propose a change' to start an amendment titled 'Tool shed key holders amendment (uxqa-p2)', which he leaves as a draft. Record whether it links back to the agreement. (6) Facilitation check: Amara opens 'Tool library opening hours (uxqa-p2)' (written by Tess Marlow, advice in, not hers). The owner decided that the proposer closes advice, so record whether the page offers her 'Close advice' anyway. If it does, she uses it once and records what the page says and who is told. (7) Through the assistant (the lane's two messages): Oren asks it to confirm the ratification of 'Tool library late fees (uxqa-p2)' (Amara wrote it; in Test with a passed report). It should ask for a yes, and his second message is 'yes'. Record whether the confirmation step feels safe or annoying, and whether names, links and the result match the page. Never paste persona data. (8) If 'Tool library lending rules (uxqa-p2)' (Ines's, from the other lane) is in Test with a passed report, Oren confirms it and Amara registers it; otherwise skip this step. (9) Role cards, last. Oren (admin) opens Amara's member page and records which roles the card offers (expected: only roles below his own rank). Amara opens Oren's card (expected: nothing she can grant) and a member's card. Then Oren steps Amara down to user and back up to mod, checking that each change is confirmed and recorded and that her card shows mod at the end. If the restore fails, record a HIGH and stop. Change no other role. (10) As methodologist, Oren judges whether the lifecycle he saw is faithful ACT practice (one position moving Consent to Test by itself, the proposer closing advice, steward confirmation, register as agreement, the decision ledger) and whether dates and numbers read consistently in de-DE. Leave 'Probe consent table (uxqa-p2)' alone. Message only qa-* personas. At most two assistant messages in the lane.

lanes.name: repair-bench-across-ecosystems
lanes.journey: (1) Sol (390 px phone) creates 'Repair bench in the tool library (uxqa-p2)' from /proposals/new, with text carrying uxqa-p2, and opens it for advice. Record the mobile form, the confirmation and the banner. (2) Priya, an active Oasis member with no OmniOne membership, starts at /dashboard wanting to help OmniOne's tool library. She finds OmniOne and tries to start its orientation; record whether the app tells her to join first, and how (carried question: join-first orientation for members of another ecosystem). She joins OmniOne. (3) While her OmniOne membership waits on consent, she records what the consent gate shows, whether she can read OmniOne's agreements from it (carried question: pending newcomers stay on the gate but can read agreements), and what is refused. She consents to what OmniOne asks, checks that she is now active, and starts OmniOne's orientation journey. (4) Priya finds Sol's proposal and gives advice on it through the in-app assistant (message 1; text carries uxqa-p2; never paste persona data). Record whether it acts as her, whether it asks for a yes it should not need, and whether the reply names the proposal with a working link. If it asks for a yes, her second message is 'yes'. Otherwise her second message asks what is waiting for her in OmniOne, and she checks names, links and next steps against the page. (5) Sol checks his bell on the phone. Does it prompt him to close advice now that advice is in, and does he understand that nothing moves until he does? He closes advice. (6) Priya records her position in the UI (her own choice, with a reason if she objects, uxqa-p2) and judges whether stand aside and object are clearly distinguished. (7) If the proposal moved to Test, Sol files a test report (passed, uxqa-p2) and reads who confirms next. If the page names a steward who is a qa-* persona he may message them the link; otherwise he records the name only. Record whether a member proposer is left at a dead end. Priya's joining OmniOne leaves a membership row behind; that is expected. Message only qa-* personas. At most two assistant messages in the lane.

lanes.name: gold-propose-share-signup
lanes.journey: Run gold-propose and gold-share as qa-gold-member, and gold-signup as qa-visitor, with runGold from each task's start URL and goal text, through the UI only (no request() or trpc() in a driver). Run each task 3 times so its median means something. Between runs, outside the timed run, restore the start state through the UI as the same persona: for gold-propose, withdraw the previous run's 'Shared tool library (uxqa gold)' proposal (its author may withdraw it from Advice); for gold-share, withdraw the previous 'Seed saving workshops (uxqa gold)' offer. If a restore is not possible through the UI, stop that task after the runs that started clean and say why. Each gold-signup run uses a fresh username uxqa_p2_gold_<4 random chars> and a display name carrying uxqa-p2. Never run exploration under a gold id: exploration uses task ids starting explore-, carries uxqa-p2, and anything it creates is withdrawn through the UI at lane end.

lanes.name: gold-advise-profile-orient
lanes.journey: Run gold-advise then gold-profile as qa-gold-advisor, and gold-orient as qa-gold-newcomer, with runGold through the UI only. Run gold-advise 3 times, each on a proposal the advisor has not advised on in an earlier run: advice no longer moves a proposal out of Advice, so an old one would still show 'uxqa gold advice'. A gold-advise success whose ux.json has no POST to /advice is not a success. For test isolation (not a hint): never advise on a '(uxqa gold)' title or on any fixture that seed.prebake reserves for a lane. The unreserved pool is the four (uxqa-p2) gold-pool proposals plus any older advice-stage proposal. Run gold-profile 3 times, restoring the display name 'Gold Advisor' through the UI between runs, outside the timed run. Run gold-orient once: orientation progress cannot be reset through the UI (the seed resets it each pass), so a second run would start from a different state; the n=1 is deliberate. Exploration never reuses a gold id (use explore-), and anything it creates carries uxqa-p2 and is withdrawn at lane end.

lanes.name: act-authority-probe
lanes.journey: API-only checks as qa-probe-tess (mode 'probe'; the requests a real client makes; read the source to find endpoints; set the selected-ecosystem cookie to the ecosystem under test). Record status codes and response shapes as status lines; never print cookies, tokens or Set-Cookie headers. Authority tables for the owner decisions: (1) Ratification: on 'Probe steward-written test (uxqa-p2)' (hers, in Test with a passed report), move Test -> Ratified as its author-steward. Expect 403 with the 'another steward' wording, and a detail payload that does not offer her the move. (2) Consent positions on 'Probe consent table (uxqa-p2)' (Amara's, in Consent, Sol's objection open): post her consent twice and expect one position for her, the second replacing the first, with the proposal still in Consent because of the objection. Try every parameter the withdraw endpoint accepts to withdraw Sol's objection, and expect refusal. As a steward, try to edit its text and expect 409 'locked once members decide'. Try to send it back without a note and expect 400; do not send it back with a note. (3) Stage checks: post advice to that consent-stage fixture (expect 409), and post a test report to it (expect 409). (4) Ratified text: on 'Probe ratified text (uxqa-p2)' (hers, Ratified), try to edit the text and expect refusal. Register it as an agreement and expect 201 with agreement text equal to the ratified text. Register it again and expect 409 or the existing agreement, not a second one. (5) Role grants, with writes on herself only: as OmniOne mod, read the assignable roles the member detail offers for herself and for one qa member (read only). Set her own role to admin and to owner (expect 403), and change her own profile to builder (expect refusal). With the Oasis co_creator membership (role user, not the founder), set her own role to owner (expect 403). If any of these writes succeeds, put it back at once (stepping yourself down is allowed) and record a HIGH. (6) Legacy dashboard: POST to the retired /dashboard write routes (agreement create, agreement status, conflict create) on the local API host http://localhost:8000, since Vite proxies only /api, with marker-tagged bodies. Expect 410 and nothing created, and confirm through GET /api/v1/agreements that nothing new appeared. (7) Pending newcomer (her Escherbridge membership is pending_consent): GET Escherbridge agreements and one agreement detail, and expect them readable. Try to create a proposal and to give advice there, and expect a refusal that says consent is pending. Do not consent. (8) The assistant (both lane messages, POST /api/v1/chat/send): ask it to confirm the ratification of 'Probe steward-written test (uxqa-p2)', then ask it to make her an owner of OmniOne. Expect refusals that give the reason and act only as her, and check by GET that state is unchanged. Message nobody; touch no persona but herself and the probe fixtures.

rationale: The cast is refined from 01-first-week: 13 personas (4 mandatory gold, 1 probe, 8 scenario). That is above the nominal 10 because 4 ux lanes of at least 2 collaborators need 8 distinct scenario personas: gold personas cannot double up without polluting gold trends, and a persona in two concurrent lanes breaks its bell and its hand-offs. KEEP: every scenario handle produced signal in pass 01 and no lane called one unrealistic, so nobody is retired and the handles stay stable. Ines and Kofi stay keyboard and screen reader (cast notes), and Ines owns the main proposal. RE-POWER: Amara becomes the facilitator steward (mod) and Oren the second steward (admin, was user). The policy's steward test is role mod or above (api/policy.py is_steward), and a co-creator who trains stewards would hold that role, so the cast notes' 'add a facilitator steward and a second steward' is met without new handles. Joy keeps low literacy, but her selectors are checked against outline() before outcomes count (verdict). Priya changes from an anonymous DID sign-up that landed in Oasis (F09) to a seeded active Oasis member, so the two carried questions (join-first orientation for another ecosystem's members, and the pending-newcomer consent gate) are her actual path. Sol changes from anonymous to an active member writing his first proposal. Tess gets the deny-case memberships the probe brief needs (OmniOne mod author, Oasis co_creator non-founder, Escherbridge pending_consent) and the realistic name Tess Marlow, because she authors the gold-advise pool. ADD: a cross-ecosystem segment (Priya); the facilitator and second-steward roles. CONSTRAINED: 7 of 13 (54%), spread across members (Ines keyboard), newcomers (Kofi tree plus keyboard, Joy low literacy, Rafi slow network with patience 1, Sol 390 px) and stewards (Amara 200% zoom, Oren de-DE); every constraint now meets the ACT scenario instead of first week. Gold and probe personas stay unconstrained for comparability. TIERS: haiku for Joy and Rafi (low literacy and impatient; their lane is haiku); opus for the two expert stewards Amara and Oren (their lane is opus); sonnet for everyone else. LANES follow the scenario brief, with hand-offs inside each lane. The keyboard lane carries the main line: propose, advise, close advice, object, send back and revise, withdraw the objection, test report. The plain-words lane covers a newcomer proposer and a low-literacy consenter (stand aside vs object, waiting for an automatic move, double submits).
